title: Console preview backend routes — start/stop/restart/status + SSE log stream
description: BETA-TEST GOAL (goal-app-preview), part 3 of 5. Hardened routes on createBoardServer (src/task-board.js) wiring the resolver (065) + process manager (066) to the console. Depends on 065 and 066.
acceptance_criteria: New hardened routes on the board server behind the EXISTING Host allowlist + Content-Type 415 + body-cap 413 guards: POST /api/preview/start, POST /api/preview/stop, POST /api/preview/restart, GET /api/preview/status.
GET /api/preview/status returns bounded JSON { state, mode, url (string|null), source, recentLogs (bounded) } sourced from the process manager + resolver (never dumps unbounded logs).

A live channel: GET /api/preview/stream (SSE) emitting incremental log lines + state changes, bounded, and cleaning up its listener on client disconnect (mirror the TASK-051 SSE-unsubscribe fix — no leak).
start resolves config via 065 and launches via 066; when mode=none, start returns a clear 409/400 with the configure hint (no crash).

tests-after: implement then prove by running (start launches a fixture app, status reflects running + url, stop terminates) + hardening parity (415/413/403) + SSE cleanup; minimal regression locks; e2e under tests/e2e/.
Bundled (task-board) change => rebuild dist + release-tier gate green.
